messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock speakers + run-of-show for the Global Inference at Scale webinar. Target format: 45m total (25m talk / 15m live demo / 5m Q&A). Can folks confirm availability and who will run the live demo? cc @alex @jamal @olivia

alex: I can run the live demo. Prefer to show Dedicated autoscaling + fallback routing. Need a 30min prep slot Wed for a dry-run. :+1:

jamal: I can take the talk (benchmarks + pragmatic cost story). Will prepare slide deck and the prompt set for evals — please share any audience examples we should highlight.

sarah: Suggest we avoid 9–11am PT to be friendly to EU attendees. What about 1pm PT (9pm CET)? Also strongly recommend a prerecorded fallback of the demo in case of region flakiness.

ops-bot: rehearsal booking created: 2024-05-08 16:00 PT — studio slot reserved. Meeting link: https://zoom.redwood-inference/rehearsal/1719123456

olivia: Draft run-of-show below — I can own the prerecorded fallback and audience routing if needed.

olivia: ```
00:00-00:02 - Host intro (maria)
00:02-00:20 - Jamal talk: Benchmarks & cost tradeoffs (slides)
00:20-00:35 - Alex live demo: Dedicated autoscale + region failover (live)
00:35-00:40 - Olivia prerecorded fallback demo (if live fails)
00:40-00:45 - Q&A + CTA (maria)
Notes: mic check 15m before; demo cluster: demo-qa-03; fallback video: /rehearsals/fallback.mp4
```

jamal: I'll need the final prompt list by Tue EOD so I can run the evals against the demo cluster and lock slides.

maria: Noted — I'll update calendar invites and send speaker one-pager template. Please send abstracts + 1-pager by Friday so we can start promo copy.

alex: I'll also record a short 3–5m clip of the critical demo path (for demo fallback + marketing clip).

sarah: @ops-bot please ensure region routing test during rehearsal window and confirm bandwidth for demo streaming. :eyes: 

ops-bot: region routing test scheduled during rehearsal. Test run id: rr-20240508-1. Will post results in this thread after rehearsal.

maria: Thanks — everyone, if you have constraints or need different timing, shout now. Otherwise I'll lock 1pm PT and send invites by EOD.
